title: Scrapbook Variations
description: Five independent scrapbook journal spreads, each made by a different imagined journal keeper, showing diverse handmade voices and ephemera traditions.
creative_direction: Independent studies for the Handmade Scrapbook Journal theme: each page belongs to a different real-feeling person with their own handwriting, taste in tape, and ephemera — together they map the diversity of imperfect-by-design journaling.
